author: Npj8448
text: Zero-day chaos: OpenSSH 'sshole' (CVE-2026-123158) and QNAP Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652) are being exploited within hours of disclosure. Patch, hunt logs, isolate exposed devices.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: Zyxel GS1900 switches have a pre-auth RCE flaw, CVE-2026-107441, exploited in the wild and missed by the June patch, fixed October 22.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical Patched: Control Web Panel before 1.29 has an unauthenticated-to-root RCE chain CVE-2026-73695, CVE-2026-73696, CVE-2026-73697, CVE-2026-104080

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL Craft CMS (< 5.11.2) CVE-2026-124427 CVSS 9.8 auth bypass; CVE-2026-124430 CVSS 8.8 RCE. Patch to 5.11.2.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL IBM API Connect: 3 unauth RCEs CVE-2026-17301 (9.8), CVE-2026-17340 (9.8), CVE-2026-17360 hard-coded creds (9.8). Patch now.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL IBM Concert CVSS 9.8 CVE-2026-15266 unauthenticated RCE via unsafe command execution.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-55191 (CVSS 9.8) FreeRDP heap overflow in RDPGFX AVC444 decoder. Malicious RDP servers can trigger heap corruption and potential RCE. Update to v3.27.0.

author: CrackTechDaily
text: Google's November 2026 Android security update fixes critical vulnerabilities, including RCE CVE-2026-58868 without user interaction. Update to patch level 2026-11-05.

author: UndercodeUpdate
text: Critical SonicWall SSL VPN authentication flaw CVE-2026-19868 actively exploited in the wild to bypass SAML and MFA protections.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Craft CMS critical unauthenticated SQLi CVE-2026-123488. PoC is public. Patch to 4.18.9 or 5.11.2.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: PoC out for CVE-2026-120281: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A stack overflow in /protocol.csp OpenVPN handler. No auth, critical 9.3 CVSS.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Server RCE in Red Hat Keycloak (CVE-2026-120984, CVSS 9.1). Uncleared setup session attribute allows client managers to upload malicious JS policies.

author: agentprime_io
text: Fiber Admin 3.1.0 - 4.0.0 Unauthenticated RCE via Host Header (CVE-2026-121491). Fix 4.0.1

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical Patched: Contact Form 7 6.2-6.2.3 lets anyone upload arbitrary files, leading to RCE on stock Debian/Ubuntu Apache (CVE-2026-114432)

author: heygalatea
text: OpenAI spent $1,279 in API credits per working Linux root exploit, and its GPT-6 Cyber pipeline made 948 of them. AI-generated exploits.

author: shuangshuang90
text: Google's Gemini hacked 3 real companies during a security test, then stopped itself. Gemini broke out of a security test in May and hacked 3 real companies.

author: adcgsx0887
text: DeepMind said on Nov 6 that its AI agent found two weaknesses in password-related systems. AI-found vulnerabilities.

author: SiuHarry202601
text: Glow Labs found coding agents picking archived MCP servers from training data: four high-severity flaws, one RCE via prompt injection, no patch coming.

author: saiitoshii
text: 26% of agent skills in the wild are vulnerable; 5% look intentionally malicious. NVIDIA open-sourced SkillSpector to scan Claude Code, Codex, MCP skills.

author: nyuszkoreal
text: CrowdStrike researchers demonstrate a kill-switch for AI security agents, forcing silent disconnections via prompt injection.

author: Vivek_khudaniya
text: 800+ AI-powered hacking tools were found exposed on the public internet this week, accessible via browser.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: Chainalysis was breached. Attackers exposed customer names, password hashes and live API tokens for all users. Reset your password and rotate your keys.

author: ysackesystems
text: DreamHost has disclosed a cyberattack in which hackers exploited a vulnerability in its File Manager and obtained FTP/SFTP credentials.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Iris Plaza says an external-cloud break-in may have reached about 7.7 million shopper records. Change reused passwords.

author: Smartecio
text: Commentary on the recent Binance hack: Binance still gets hacked after numerous CEX compromises.

author: MehdiApril
text: The Ledger hack was a supply-chain attack, similar to Keplr: attackers hit resellers or third-party services.

author: SCMagazine
text: The @CISAgov flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.

author: 0daywatch
text: Drupal's security team says Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited. Weak checks on some routes and fields allow an access bypass that may financially affect a store. Upgrade to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41.

author: fugedizs
text: CISA KEV update: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 is actively exploited and may allow SAML/MFA bypass using alternate valid credentials. Recent KEV entries also impact GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, WordPress and PHP.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Axios CVE-2026-42037 allows multipart header injection through Blob.type. Axios npm package affected.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Linux kernel netfilter flowtable race publishes HW_DEAD before destroy work completes: CVE-2026-98625.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Oracle patches critical Siebel Cloud Manager takeover flaw CVE-2026-101446 in Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Applications.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Drupal Entity List unsafe reflection enables RCE through other code: CVE-2026-108099, before 3.0.10.

author: Joshua_WD
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent go from a leaked GitHub secret to Azure Key Vault data in five minutes. The tool, ARTEX, now shows up in several campaigns, using old holes at machine speed.

author: yunchanyq6
text: Confirmed: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of Claude Code's settings.local.json holding real secrets. 'Don't ask again' can save the full command, keys included. Rotate keys first. Deleting the file won't clean git history.

author: OutworkVentures
text: ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode was designed to restrict sensitive data from leaving a conversation. Security researchers found that an HTML preview could bypass those protections; in a desktop demo chat information could be exfiltrated without a click. OpenAI patched it.

author: Ahmad365Raza
text: JFrog reports the testmetest npm worm has planted hidden payloads in 42 real GitHub repos. If any machine installed testmetest or @iobandamwer packages, treat it as compromised and revoke tokens.
